principles.label: UCB1 Online Learning
principles.cite: Auer, Cesa-Bianchi, Fischer (2002). Finite-time Analysis of the Multiarmed Bandit Problem. Machine Learning 47(2-3):235-256.
principles.verbatim: The regret is the loss due to the fact that the globally optimal policy is not followed all the times.
principles.applies_to: strategy_rewards table; UCB1 score = win_rate + sqrt(2*ln(N)/n_i) drives leaderboard ranking.
principles.pipeline_query: SELECT strategy_name, wins, total_trials FROM strategy_rewards WHERE total_trials > 0 ORDER BY CAST(wins AS REAL)/total_trials DESC

principles.label: Idempotence
principles.cite: Lamport (1978). Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events in a Distributed System. CACM 21(7):558-565.
principles.verbatim: The occurrence of an event in one process can affect other processes only through the messages it sends.
principles.verbatim_evidence: Lamport 1978 CACM -- canonical paper; quote is from p.559. Verbatim status: sourced from ACM DL which returned 403 in this session. Marked as training-memory for this field pending a new fetch run.

principles.pipeline_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auto_heal_actions WHERE old_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND new_sha256 IS NOT NULL

principles.verbatim: Design by contract (DbC) prescribes that software designers should define formal, precise and verifiable interface specifications for software components, which extend the ordinary definition of abstract data types with preconditions, postconditions and invariants.

principles.label: Durable Execution (DBOS)
principles.cite: Skiadopoulos et al. (2022). DBOS: A Proposal for a Data-Centric Operating System. PVLDB 15(1):21-30.
principles.verbatim: DBOS makes programs durable by running them atop a database: every function call is a transaction, so programs automatically recover from failures by replaying from the last committed transaction.
principles.verbatim_evidence: www.vldb.org returned 403 in this fetch session. Verbatim status: training_memory_pending_reverification. DOI confirmed: 10.14778/3485450.3485454.
principles.applies_to: pipeline_runs table records every run as a committed transaction. verbatim_logs table enables replay. WAL mode ensures durability across crashes.
principles.pipeline_query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM pipeline_runs GROUP BY status
